# .NET Interactive Notebooks


## File Extensions


```
.dib    → .NET Interactive notebook format (recommended)
.ipynb  → Jupyter notebook format (compatible)
```


## Kernel Selection


```csharp
// At top of notebook or per cell
#!csharp      // C# (default)
#!fsharp      // F#
#!pwsh        // PowerShell
#!javascript  // JavaScript
#!html        // HTML
#!sql         // SQL
#!markdown    // Markdown
```


## Loading Code


### Import Source Files


```csharp
#!import MyClass.cs                    // Import C# source file
#!import ./Models/DicomStudy.cs        // Relative path
#!import ../Shared/Utilities.cs        // Parent directory
```


### Reference DLLs


```csharp
#r "path/to/MyLibrary.dll"                           // Compiled assembly
#r "../MyProject/bin/Debug/net9.0/MyProject.dll"     // Project output
```


### NuGet Packages


```csharp
#r "nuget: PackageName"                    // Latest version
#r "nuget: Newtonsoft.Json, 13.0.3"       // Specific version
#r "nuget: fo-dicom, 5.1.2"               // DICOM library example
```


## Variable Sharing Between Kernels


```csharp
// C# cell
var patientCount = 42;
```

```fsharp
// F# cell - access C# variable
#!fsharp
#!share --from csharp patientCount
printfn "Patient count: %d" patientCount
```

```javascript
// JavaScript cell - access C# variable
#!javascript
#!share --from csharp patientCount
console.log(`Patient count: ${patientCount}`);
```


## Display & Output


### Basic Output


```csharp
Console.WriteLine("Simple text");
Console.Write($"Inline: {value}");
```


### Rich Display


```csharp
// Display objects
var study = new DicomStudy("UID123", "P001", "CT", DateTime.Now, 150);
display(study);                    // Displays as formatted object

// Display collections as tables
var studies = GetStudies();
display(studies);                  // Auto-formats as table

// Display HTML
display(
    HTML("<h3>Patient Statistics</h3><p>Total: 42</p>")
);

// Display markdown
display(
    Markdown("## Results\n- Item 1\n- Item 2")
);
```


### Multiple Outputs


```csharp
Console.WriteLine("First output");
display("Second output");
return "Third output";  // Last expression auto-displayed
```


## Magic Commands Reference


```
Code Loading:
#!import <file>          Load C# source file
#r <dll>                 Reference assembly/NuGet

Kernel Control:
#!csharp                 Switch to C# kernel
#!fsharp                 Switch to F# kernel
#!pwsh                   Switch to PowerShell
#!javascript             Switch to JavaScript
#!html                   Switch to HTML
#!markdown               Switch to Markdown

Variable Sharing:
#!share --from <kernel> <variable>     Share variable from another kernel
#!set --name <var> --value <val>       Set variable from magic command

Time Measurement:
#!time                   Measure cell execution time

Help & Info:
#!about                  Show notebook info
#!lsmagic                List all magic commands
```


## Keyboard Shortcuts


```
Shift + Enter    → Run cell and move to next
Ctrl + Enter     → Run cell and stay
Alt + Enter      → Run cell and insert below
Esc              → Command mode
Enter            → Edit mode
A                → Insert cell above (command mode)
B                → Insert cell below (command mode)
DD               → Delete cell (command mode)
```


## Timing & Performance


```csharp
#!time
// Your code here - execution time will be shown
var result = ExpensiveOperation();
```


## Working with Multiple Languages


```
Workflow Diagram:
─────────────────

┌─────────────┐
│  C# Cell    │  Load & process DICOM data
│  (Analysis) │  
└──────┬──────┘
       │ #!share
       ▼
┌─────────────┐
│  F# Cell    │  Statistical analysis
│  (Stats)    │
└──────┬──────┘
       │ #!share
       ▼
┌─────────────┐
│ JavaScript  │  Create interactive charts
│ (Viz)       │
└─────────────┘
```


**Example:**


```csharp
// C# Cell
var studies = new[] { 
    new { Modality = "CT", Count = 150 },
    new { Modality = "MR", Count = 200 }
};
```

```javascript
// JavaScript Cell
#!javascript
#!share --from csharp studies
console.log(studies);
// Use with Chart.js, D3.js, etc.
```


## Common Patterns


### Pattern 1: Load Library + Use


```csharp
// Cell 1: Setup
#r "nuget: Newtonsoft.Json, 13.0.3"
using Newtonsoft.Json;
```

```csharp
// Cell 2: Use
var json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(myObject);
Console.WriteLine(json);
```


### Pattern 2: Import Models + Analyze


```csharp
// Cell 1: Import
#!import DicomModels.cs
using RadiologyModels;
```

```csharp
// Cell 2: Load data
var studies = LoadStudies();
display(studies);
```

```csharp
// Cell 3: Analyze
var stats = DicomAnalyzer.AnalyzeByModality(studies);
display(stats);
```


### Pattern 3: Multi-language Pipeline


```csharp
// Cell 1: C# - Data preparation
var processedData = studies
    .Where(s => s.Modality == "CT")
    .Select(s => new { s.PatientID, s.NumberOfImages })
    .ToList();
```

```fsharp
// Cell 2: F# - Statistical analysis
#!fsharp
#!share --from csharp processedData

let avgImages = 
    processedData 
    |> Seq.averageBy (fun x -> float x.NumberOfImages)
    
printfn "Average images: %.2f" avgImages
```

```javascript
// Cell 3: JavaScript - Visualization
#!javascript
#!share --from csharp processedData
// Create chart with processedData
```

## Quick Reference: C# vs Python Notebooks


```
Feature              Jupyter (Python)           .NET Interactive
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
File extension       .ipynb                     .dib or .ipynb
Magic commands       %pip install               #r "nuget:"
Import code          from module import         #!import file.cs
Display              display(obj)               display(obj)
Rich output          IPython.display            HTML(), Markdown()
Multi-language       %%javascript               #!javascript
Variable share       N/A (same kernel)          #!share --from
Time execution       %%time                     #!time
```


## Pro Tips


```
✓ Use #!import for frequent iterations (auto-reloads)
✓ Use #r for stable compiled libraries
✓ Keep each cell focused on one task
✓ Use display() for rich object visualization
✓ Restart kernel if imported .cs files change
✓ Use #!time to identify slow operations
✓ Save notebooks as .dib for better git diffs
```


## Common Issues & Solutions


```
Problem: Changes in .cs file not reflected
Solution: Restart kernel (click restart button or Ctrl+Shift+P → "Restart")

Problem: "Namespace not found"
Solution: Add 'using' statement after #!import

Problem: NuGet package not loading
Solution: Check package name/version, restart kernel

Problem: Variable not shared between kernels
Solution: Use #!share --from <kernel> <variable>
```


## Example: Complete Radiology Workflow


```csharp
// Cell 1: Setup
#!import DicomModels.cs
#r "nuget: Newtonsoft.Json, 13.0.3"

using RadiologyModels;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
```

```csharp
// Cell 2: Load data
var jsonData = File.ReadAllText("studies.json");
var studies = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<List<DicomStudy>>(jsonData);
Console.WriteLine($"Loaded {studies.Count} studies");
```

```csharp
// Cell 3: Analysis
var ctStudies = studies.Where(s => s.Modality == "CT").ToList();
var stats = DicomAnalyzer.AnalyzeByModality(ctStudies);
display(stats);
```

```csharp
// Cell 4: Export results
var resultJson = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(stats, Formatting.Indented);
File.WriteAllText("ct_statistics.json", resultJson);
Console.WriteLine("✓ Results exported");
```
